purpose: Read-only diagnostic to confirm Codex and GitHub execution path before dispatching the Boundary Reaper harness work order.
authority: Owner-directed; no live Reaper mutation authorized.
command: set -u; echo '=== CODEX PATH ==='; command -v codex || true; codex --version 2>&1 || true; echo '=== GITHUB AUTH ==='; gh auth status 2>&1 || true; echo '=== GIT REMOTE ==='; git remote -v 2>&1 || true; echo '=== CODEX EXEC HELP ==='; codex exec --help 2>&1 | sed -n '1,180p'; echo '=== CODEX APP-SERVER HELP ==='; codex app-server --help 2>&1 | sed -n '1,180p'; echo '=== END ==='
